collections.name: Elder Futhark
collections.description: A provenance-backed canonical 24-rune Elder Futhark collection. Names and lexical values are explicitly scholarly reconstructions; later rune-poem systems remain separate.

metadata.unicode_name: RUNIC LETTER FEHU FEOH FE F
RUNIC LETTER RAIDO RAD REID R

metadata.uncertainty_notes: The familiar normalized label Kenaz is retained for navigation; UT's Krause-based chart gives kaunan and ‘sickness’. Competing reconstructions make the name/lexeme especially uncertain.

metadata.unicode_name: RUNIC LETTER NAUDIZ NYD NAUD N
RUNIC LETTER ISAZ IS ISS I

metadata.uncertainty_notes: The rune's exact historical phonetic value is uncertain; UT transliterates it æ in the chart.
The name and lexical reconstruction are debated. UT's Krause-based chart gives perþō and ‘fruit tree’; the corpus does not present this as settled.
The Elder form and its Old English Eolh-secg and Scandinavian Ýr descendants form a difficult, non-identical relationship; all three poem mappings are marked likely-related.

metadata.unicode_name: RUNIC LETTER TIWAZ TIR TYR T
RUNIC LETTER BERKANAN BEORC BJARKAN B
RUNIC LETTER LAUKAZ LAGU LOGR L
metadata.uncertainty_notes: The normalized label Laguz is conventional; UT's Krause-based reconstruction is laukaz ‘leek’, while later poem descendants have water-related names.
